datasheet_id_and_revision: SNOSA84F, August 2003, revised March 2013 (appended package option addendum 11-Nov-2025, package materials 10-Aug-2026)
scope_of_this_file: Headline specifications (survey scope for this part); curves not digitized are marked as such.
citation_convention: pN = 1-based PDF page index; printed page number equals N for p1-p18. EC = Electrical Characteristics table. Fig N = datasheet figure number.
value_types: TYP = typical; MIN/MAX = limits; boldface rows = over-temperature limits (-40 to 85 C). EC footnote (p2): values apply for factory testing with TJ = TA; 'Min/Max ratings are based on product characterization and simulation. Individual parameters are tested as noted.' LSBW and slew rate are '100% tested' (p1 features). CURVE = read from plot.
input_type: bipolar (VIP10 complementary bipolar process, p1; not stated explicitly as bipolar)

min_stable_gain.conditions: AV = +1 with RF = 0 (buffer: output shorted directly to -IN, p15)
min_stable_gain.what_datasheet_says: Unity gain stable (p1, p11). p15: operates best with RF ~250 Ohm for gains >= +2 and <= -1; large RF at low gains exaggerates parasitic capacitance (ringing, peaking). TIA section p16: CF = CD/2 as a starting point; lower CF peaks the response.

supply.dual_or_single: dual (nominal +/-3.3 V to +/-6 V); single-supply circuits shown (Fig 34, Fig 35)
supply.recommended: Nominal +/-3.3 V to +/-6 V for supplies with 10% regulation or better (p2 operating ratings); EC at +/-5 V and +/-3.3 V; p1: 6.6 V to 12 V supply range, 'specified at 6.6V and 10V'

phase_margin_or_crossover.note: Fig 29/30 open-loop gain and phase not digitized (headline-only scope)

open_loop_curve.conditions: load not stated; x axis 100 Hz-1 GHz
open_loop_curve.phase_convention: phase of AOL, 0 deg at low frequency (right axis -180..+180 deg, 0 deg aligned with the 40 dB gridline), decreasing

open_loop_output_impedance.note: Open-loop Zout not given. Closed-loop output resistance 0.3 Ohm (+/-5 V EC, p3) and .05 Ohm (+/-3.3 V EC, p4); Fig 31 (p10) |Z|OUT vs f 0.001-100 MHz (not digitized; visually ~0.025-0.04 Ohm at low f, tens of Ohm at 100 MHz).

closed_loop_small_signal_bw.conditions: AV = +2, RF = 250, VOUT = 0.5 Vpp, RL = 100, VS = +/-5 V
AV = +1, 0.25 Vpp, VS = +/-3.3 V (180 MHz at AV = +2, 0.5 Vpp; 0.1 dB BW 40 MHz at 1 Vpp)

slew_rate.conditions: 4 V step, VS = +/-5 V, average of rising and falling 40-60% slew rates

rise_fall_settling.conditions: rise and fall, 1 V step, +/-5 V

voltage_noise.curve_note: Fig 20 (p9) voltage and current noise 1 Hz-1 MHz (not digitized); visually voltage noise flattens near 3 nV/rtHz by ~100 kHz

current_noise.hf_behavior: not specified above 1 MHz (Fig 20 ends at 1 MHz; visually flat ~1.5 pA/rtHz above ~100 kHz)

input_capacitance.definition_notes: Single EC row 'CIN Input Capacitance 1.2 pF' (TYP, +/-5 V); common-mode vs differential not stated. RIN 1 MOhm.

input_bias_current.conditions: +/-5 V; max +/-5 (25 C), +/-8 (over T); drift 11 nA/C

input_offset_voltage.conditions: +/-5 V; max +/-2.5 (25 C), +/-3.5 (over T); drift 4 uV/C

distortion.conditions: Fig 25 (+/-3.3 V) and Fig 26 (+/-5 V) HD2/HD3 vs frequency not digitized; visually HD2 ~-55 and HD3 ~-43 near 50 MHz at +/-5 V

packages.name: SOIC-8 (D, D0008A)
packages.notes: thetaJC 65 C/W (operating ratings p2); application text p15 gives thetaJA 148 C/W; LMH6609MA/NOPB (tube 95), MAX/NOPB (T&R 2500); EVM LMH730227

packages.name: SOT-23-5 (DBV, DBV0005A)
packages.notes: thetaJC 120 C/W (p2); application text p15 gives thetaJA 250 C/W; LMH6609MF/NOPB (T&R 1000), MFX/NOPB (3000), marking A89A; EVM LMH730216

pinout_notes: SOT-23-5: 1 OUT, 2 V-, 3 +IN, 4 -IN, 5 V+. SOIC-8: 1 N/C, 2 -IN, 3 +IN, 4 V-, 5 N/C, 6 OUTPUT, 7 V+, 8 N/C. The captions under the two drawings are swapped (SOT-23 says D0008A, SOIC says DBV0005A). (p5)

tia_content.what: Transimpedance amplifier circuit and starting-point compensation rule
tia_content.C_F: CF = CD/2 as a starting point ('Lower feedback capacitors will peak frequency response')
tia_content.figure_or_section: p16 'TRANSIMPEDANCE AMPLIFIER', Fig 38 (VOUT = -IIN x RF; +IN grounded)

application_guidance: p15: RF ~250 Ohm best for |gain| >= 2; RF much below 100 Ohm loads the output (less swing, more distortion); buffer: short output to -IN; SMT parts, no wire-wound resistors. p14: ground plane removed near input/output pins; 10 uF tantalum + 0.01 uF per supply plus optional 0.1 uF V+ to V- for HD2; series ROUT for capacitive loads (Fig 13: ~55 Ohm at 10 pF, ~15 Ohm at 100 pF, chosen for <= 0.5 dB peaking). p13: closed-loop BW ~ 240 MHz/AV for AV > 5; fMAX = SR/(2 pi VP). p16: 'low input current noise and unity gain stability ... excellent choice for transimpedance applications'.
abs_max_and_input_protection: VS +/-6.6 V; IOUT limited by power dissipation; common-mode input V+ to V-; TJ 150 C; ESD 2000 V HBM, 200 V MM (p2). ESD diodes conduct if a large input is applied while unpowered (p16).
other_notes: GBP stated as 240 MHz (p13) while the AV = +1 small-signal bandwidth is 900 MHz and AV = +2 is 260 MHz (p2).
Output drive text says '100mA of output current' (p13) vs 90 mA typ linear output current (p1, p3).
Thermal resistance: operating ratings 145 C/W (SOIC) and 187 C/W (SOT-23) vs application text 148 and 250 C/W (p2 vs p15).
+/-3.3 V EC row 'ROUT Input Resistance Close Loop .05 Ohm' mixes labels; +/-5 V closed-loop ROUT is 0.3 Ohm (p3, p4).
VN unit at +/-3.3 V printed as 'nV/ pA/rtHz' (p4).
Package captions swapped on the connection diagram (p5).
Not digitized: open-loop gain/phase (Fig 29/30), noise curve (Fig 20), HD vs f (Fig 25/26), |Z|OUT (Fig 31).
pages_read: All 30 pages rendered and read at 160 dpi (p1-p18 datasheet body, p19-p20 addendum, p21-p23 package materials, p24-p29 mechanical/land/stencil drawings, p30 notice). No zoomed digitizing done for this part.
